name: creativity-engine-mcp
description: AI-powered creativity engine MCP server for agents. Supports find bisociations, assess creativity, compute novelty. By MEOK AI Labs.

tools.name: find_bisociations
tools.description: Find creative bisociations between two concepts (Koestler's theory). Discovers hidden connections across domains.

tools.name: assess_creativity
tools.description: Score an idea across 5 creativity dimensions: novelty, utility, surprise, elegance, feasibility.

tools.name: compute_novelty
tools.description: Compute novelty score by comparing against known solutions in the QD archive.

tools.name: suggest_exploration
tools.description: Suggest unexplored conceptual territories for creative exploration.
